title: Kissed Dutch Corn Pancakes
description: Floral, chewy pancakes with a midnight flare, made with corn flour, whey protein, and a dash of flambe for that Dutch twist.
instructions: Whisk the corn flour, whey protein, baking powder, and sea salt in a bowl until smooth.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs, almond milk, honey, and vanilla until combined.
Combine the wet and dry mixtures, stirring gently until just mixed.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the melted butter.
Pour a 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet for each pancake, then spread blueberries over the surface.
Cook until bubbles form on top, about 2-3 minutes, then flip and cook the other side for another 2 minutes.
Repeat with remaining batter, keeping pancakes warm.
Serve pancakes hot, drizzle with maple syrup, and finish with a flambe of a small amount of butter and a splash of brandy, igniting for a dramatic effect.
Enjoy the floral aroma and chewy texture as a midnight craving delight.
